capabilities: Play back notes as speech from the statusbar or ribbon
Speak only the selected text while in edit mode
Detect the note's language and pick a matching voice
Override language detection with a lang frontmatter property
Expose an API so other plugins can add text-to-speech
extras: Does not work on Android due to a Webview bug; voices depend on the native OS API, so new languages must be added via Windows 10, MacOS or iOS documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to have notes read aloud, so users must leave the app or copy text elsewhere to hear them.

relations.evidence: usable with other plugins (currently RSS Reader)

summary: Plugin that reads notes aloud using the operating system's native text-to-speech voices, started from the statusbar or ribbon.
